question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        m.customer_id,
        m.payment_month,
        m.monthly_total,
        LAG(m.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY m.customer_id ORDER BY m.payment_month) AS prev_month_total,
        m.monthly_total - LAG(m.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY m.customer_id ORDER BY m.payment_month) AS month_over_month_diff
    FROM monthly_payments m
)
SELECT 
    wd.customer_id,
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name,
    wd.payment_month,
    ROUND(wd.month_over_month_diff, 2) AS month_over_month_diff
FROM with_diff wd
JOIN customer c ON wd.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE wd.month_over_month_diff IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(wd.month_over_month_diff) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        m.customer_id,
        m.payment_month,
        m.monthly_total,
        LAG(m.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY m.customer_id ORDER BY m.payment_month) AS prev_month_total,
        m.monthly_total - LAG(m.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY m.customer_id ORDER BY m.payment_month) AS month_over_month_diff
    FROM monthly_payments m
)
SELECT 
    wd.customer_id,
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name,
    wd.payment_month,
    ROUND(wd.month_over_month_diff, 2) AS month_over_month_diff
FROM with_diff wd
JOIN customer c ON wd.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE wd.month_over_month_diff IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(wd.month_over_month_diff) DESC
LIMIT 1;
